1) 从告警标签取 zone，在 Cloudflare Dashboard 的: 1) Take zone from the alert labels and drill down by status code in Analytics in the Cloudflare Dashboard, separating 520-527 (between Cloudflare and the origin) from 500-504 (the origin itself); 2) 52x means an origin connection problem: 521 is the origin refusing the connection and 524 is the origin timing out; curl the origin IP directly and check whether the origin firewall allows Cloudflare's origin fetch ranges; 3) If the 5xx come from the origin, locate them in the origin application logs; 4) As an emergency measure enable Always Online or temporarily point the DNS record at a backup origin.
1) 从告警标签取 zone，在 Dashboard 的 Caching \u0: 1) Take zone from the alert labels and use Caching > Cache Analytics in the Dashboard to see which paths the misses concentrate on; 2) Check whether Page Rules or Cache Rules changed recently; a misconfigured Bypass Cache is the most common cause, so roll the change back first; 3) A change in origin response headers (a new Cache-Control: no-cache or Set-Cookie) also invalidates caching; compare headers before and after the release; 4) If you just ran Purge Everything, the cache is rebuilding as expected; watch whether the hit ratio recovers naturally within a few hours.
1) 从告警标签取 zone，在 Security \u003e Events: 1) Take zone from the alert labels and aggregate Security > Events by source country, ASN, and User-Agent to characterise the attack; 2) Once the pattern is clear, configure a WAF custom rule or rate limiting rule, preferring pattern matching over IP blocking; 3) For high-volume attacks enable Under Attack Mode, bearing in mind it presents a challenge page to legitimate users so the business impact must be assessed; 4) At the same time check whether origin 5xx and response time are affected, and scale the origin first if needed before tuning rules.

该 Zone 的 5xx 响应占比超过 1%，用户访问已有相当比例失败，通常是源: This zone's 5xx response ratio exceeds 1%, so a meaningful share of user requests is already failing. It is normally an origin failure or a problem on the link between Cloudflare and the origin.
该 Zone 的缓存命中率已跌到昨日同一时段的 70% 以下。回源流量随之放大，: This zone's cache hit ratio has fallen below 70% of the same window yesterday. Origin traffic scales up accordingly, raising origin load and bandwidth cost, and in severe cases overwhelming the origin.
该 Zone 被 Cloudflare 判定为威胁的请求占比超过 10%，说明正: More than 10% of this zone's requests are classified as threats by Cloudflare, indicating scanning, bots, or DDoS. They are blocked, but they still consume quota and some may leak through to the origin.
该规则用昨日同一时段作为基线做同比，不设固定阈值，避免不同站点缓存率差异导致的误: This rule compares against the same window yesterday instead of using a fixed threshold, so sites with different baseline cache ratios do not produce false positives; it produces no data for a zone that has been live for less than 24 hours.
